title: Painting Contractor in Gainesville & Ocala, FL
description: Locally owned painting contractor for Gainesville, Ocala, and North Central Florida. Interior, exterior, commercial, and cabinet work. Free written estimates.
h1: North Central Florida Painting Contractor Serving Gainesville & Ocala
heroIntro: Homes, kitchens, storefronts, and church halls from Gainesville to Ocala, prepped by hand and finished in top-tier Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore coatings by painters on our own payroll. Every system is picked to outlast Florida sun, humidity, and summer storms.

sections.h2: Every kind of painting work, handled by one local crew
body: Owned and run right here in the region, we are a painting contractor serving Gainesville, Ocala, and North Central Florida. We paint living rooms and kitchen cabinets, stucco and lap siding, storefronts and church halls, and we do it with our own crews instead of handing the work off to subcontractors. Whoever measures your place and writes up the price stays on site as the lead until the last coat dries.

For houses, the most common requests are interior repaints, exterior house painting, and cabinet refinishing. Shop owners, offices, and HOA boards tend to ask for commercial painting timed around business hours. Each service below has its own page explaining what is included.

sections.h2: A painting company that exceeds expectations
bullets: Licensed, Bonded & Insured|Florida licensed and bonded, with workers' comp covering each painter. Boards, landlords, and businesses receive a COI listing their own entity ahead of mobilization.
Our Own Crews|No subcontracted labor, ever. Everyone holding a brush at your address works for us and answers to the lead who quoted it.
Itemized Written Estimates|Every surface, prep task, product name, number of coats, and date is written down, and any change needs your signature first.
15+ Years of Experience|More than fifteen years of painting in this climate, so we know what Florida heat, moisture, and pollen do to a coating.

sections.h2: Not sure about color? Start with a consultation
body: A swatch that looks right under store lighting can turn chalky or harsh in Florida afternoon sun. Our color consultation service tests choices on your own walls and siding, in the light they'll actually live in, before the crew opens a can.
bullets: Full-Size Drawdowns|We paint real samples big enough to judge, so you aren't guessing from a two-inch chip.
Exact Color Matching|Hand us a paint chip, a cabinet door, or that half-empty can from the garage shelf and we will reproduce the shade.
Sheen Guidance|Flat, eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss, picked for how each room gets used and cleaned.

sections.h2: A written warranty and a walkthrough you sign
body: No project closes until you have toured it with us at the end; whatever you point out on that tour is corrected first, which is how our satisfaction guarantee works. After that, a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years on exterior projects takes over, layered on the paint manufacturer's coverage, and labeled leftover paint stays with you for the occasional scuff.

sections.h2: Painting across five North Central Florida counties
body: Our map covers 15 cities in five counties (Alachua, Marion, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist), reaching from Gainesville and Newberry down to Ocala and out to Lake City, Chiefland, and Trenton. Staying regional keeps us close: a crew lead can usually see your property within 48 hours of the call, and coming back years later for a warranty item is a short drive. Choose your county or city below, or browse the full North Central Florida service area.

sections.h2: Painting on Florida's schedule, not a textbook's
body: Here, the calendar matters as much as the brush. The stretch from October through May is prime time for siding and stucco. During the summer months, crews clock in at first light and track the dew point and the weather radar so a wet coat never meets a 3 p.m. downpour. Inside work has no season at all, and you can stay home while the crew covers your furniture and finishes one room before starting another.

Product choices follow the same local logic: a 100% acrylic for siding and trim, an elastomeric where stucco shows hairline movement, and a waterborne urethane enamel for cabinets and doors, always applied in no fewer than two full coats. Our Florida painting guides explain why prep makes up most of the labor on nearly every job.

faqs.a: Fifteen towns spread over five counties, Alachua, Marion, Levy, Columbia, and Gilchrist. That list runs from Gainesville, Ocala, and Newberry to High Springs, Lake City, Williston, Chiefland, Dunnellon, Belleview, Trenton, and more.

Yes on all counts: Florida licensed, bonded, carrying full insurance, and covering every employee on the crew with workers' comp. Need paperwork for an HOA, a management firm, or your company? We will send a certificate of insurance with that name on it before mobilizing.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get an estimate?
faqs.a: Fast. Most people get a site visit within 48 hours of reaching out, then a line-by-line written price roughly one business day afterward. It costs nothing and commits you to nothing.

Yes, in writing. Exterior jobs carry up to 10 years of workmanship coverage from us, separate from whatever the paint company warrants. And before that clock even starts, any flaw spotted on the closing walkthrough is repaired.
